purpose_context: Since Vikunja's RRULE cutover on 2026-10-30, a task's recurrence lives in a 'repeat' rule object and the old repeat_after/repeat_mode fields are gone. Several Felix write paths build their own narrow update bodies, which the server treats as full replacements, so habits, auto-skips, escalation completions and intake moves strip the rule and reminders. The weekly report comes out empty, and the test suite still passes because its fixtures encode the old shape. This mission fixes every affected Felix caller, adds regression tests that prove the rule survives each write, updates the agent guidance, and adopts native recurrence where it removes Felix-side date arithmetic. Tracked in kentonium3/kg-automation#1111.
purpose_tldr: Stop Felix from silently stripping recurrence rules from Vikunja tasks, and adapt every Felix calendar, habit, escalation and intake function to Vikunja's RRULE model.
